focus_sessions_state_consistent.name: focus_sessions_state_consistent
focus_sessions_state_consistent.value: ("focus_sessions"."status" = 'active' and "focus_sessions"."ended_at" is null and "focus_sessions"."duration_minutes" is null) or ("focus_sessions"."status" <> 'active' and "focus_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "focus_sessions"."duration_minutes" is not null)

goals_values_nonnegative.name: goals_values_nonnegative
goals_values_nonnegative.value: ("goals"."target_value" is null or "goals"."target_value" >= 0) and ("goals"."current_value" is null or "goals"."current_value" >= 0)

goals_date_order.name: goals_date_order
goals_date_order.value: "goals"."start_date" is null or "goals"."deadline" is null or "goals"."start_date" <= "goals"."deadline"

projects_date_order.name: projects_date_order
projects_date_order.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."deadline" is null or "projects"."start_date" <= "projects"."deadline"

tasks_durations_nonnegative.name: tasks_durations_nonnegative
tasks_durations_nonnegative.value: ("tasks"."estimated_minutes" is null or "tasks"."estimated_minutes" >= 0) and ("tasks"."actual_minutes" is null or "tasks"."actual_minutes" >= 0)

tasks_schedule_order.name: tasks_schedule_order
tasks_schedule_order.value: "tasks"."scheduled_start" is null or "tasks"."scheduled_end" is null or "tasks"."scheduled_start" <= "tasks"."scheduled_end"
